" ============================================================================
"  VIMTUTOR ADVANCED -- shared configuration for Vim 9+ and Neovim 0.10+
"
"  This file is SOURCED by ~/.vimrc and by ~/.config/nvim/init.vim (both
"  created by setup.sh), so one configuration serves both editors. It is
"  written to be safe WITHOUT any plugins: every plugin-specific block is
"  guarded, so it degrades to a plain, comfortable editor until
"  :PlugInstall has run. Edit freely -- it is your config; setup.sh never
"  rewrites it after first creation.
"
"  Layout of this file:
"    1. plugin-less defaults (options that matter)
"    2. your keys: leader + mappings
"    3. colorscheme handling (:Theme)
"    4. plugins via vim-plug, guarded per editor
"    5. per-plugin configuration (coc.nvim, status line, treesitter, fzf)
" ============================================================================

" --- 0. make this file self-sufficient --------------------------------------
" The repo root (parent of config/) is put on runtimepath if missing, so
" :Tutor works even when sourced by hand.

let g:vimtutor_data = get(g:, 'vimtutor_data', expand('~/.local/share/vimtutor'))
let g:vimtutor_plugdir = get(g:, 'vimtutor_plugdir', g:vimtutor_data . '/plugged')

let s:tutor_home = fnamemodify(expand('<sfile>:p:h:h'), ':p:h')
if &runtimepath !~# (escape(s:tutor_home, ',\') . '\>')
  execute 'set runtimepath^=' . fnameescape(s:tutor_home)
endif

" --- 1. options that matter --------------------------------------------------

if !has('nvim')
  set encoding=utf-8
endif

filetype plugin indent on
syntax on

" Buffers switch without a save prompt; history survives restarts.
set hidden
if &undodir == '' || &undodir ==# '.'
  try
    call mkdir(g:vimtutor_data . '/undo', 'p')
    let &undodir = g:vimtutor_data . '/undo//'
  catch
  endtry
endif
if isdirectory(expand(&undodir))
  set undofile
endif

" Layout: split where your eyes are; keep context at the edges.
set splitbelow splitright
set scrolloff=8
set cursorline
set number relativenumber
set signcolumn=yes  " diagnostics reserve their gutter (coc likes this)

" Search the way you meant it: case-insensitive until CamelCase.
set incsearch hlsearch ignorecase smartcase

" Command line niceties.
set wildmenu
set wildmode=longest:full,full
set wildignore+=*.o,*.obj,*.pyc,*.so,*~,node_modules,.git,.zig-cache
set pumheight=15

" :find anywhere under the project root (Lesson 10).
set path+=**

" Real typing defaults; vim-sleuth adapts per file when installed.
set backspace=indent,eol,start
set tabstop=4 shiftwidth=4 expandtab
set smartindent
set breakindent showbreak=..
if !has('nvim')
  set nolazyredraw
endif

" Input and feedback.
set mouse=a
set timeout timeoutlen=500 ttimeoutlen=10
set updatetime=300
if has('nvim')
  set inccommand=split
endif

" True color where the terminal promises it (schemes like tokyonight
" are unusable otherwise).
let s:tgc = (exists('$COLORTERM') && $COLORTERM =~# 'truecolor\|24bit')
      \ || (exists('$KITTY_WINDOW_ID') || exists('$WEZTERM_PANE'))
if has('termguicolors') && s:tgc
  set termguicolors
endif

" A decent bare status line; airline/lualine replace it when installed.
set laststatus=2
set statusline=%<\ %f\ %y\ %m%r%=%-10.(%l,%c%V%)\ %P

" --- 2. your keys ------------------------------------------------------------

let g:mapleader = ' '
let g:maplocalleader = ','

" Files and windows
nnoremap <silent> <leader>w    :write<CR>
nnoremap <silent> <leader>x    :x<CR>
nnoremap <silent> <leader>q    :quit<CR>      " close THIS window
nnoremap <silent> <leader>v    :vsplit<CR>
nnoremap <silent> <leader>s    :split<CR>
nnoremap <silent> <leader>=    <C-W>=         " equalize splits

" Tabs and buffers
nnoremap <silent> <leader>t    :tabnew<CR>
nnoremap <silent> <leader>bl   :ls<CR>
nnoremap <silent> <leader>bb   :buffer<Space>
nnoremap <silent> <leader>e    :Explore<CR>

" Search niceties
nnoremap <silent> <leader>h    :nohlsearch<CR>

" --- 3. colorschemes ----------------------------------------------------------

" Default theme per editor; override in the line above this comment block
" or with :Theme<name>!  (the bang writes the choice back to this file).
let g:vimtutor_theme = get(g:, 'vimtutor_theme', has('nvim') ? 'tokyonight' : 'gruvbox')

function! s:VimtutorTheme(name, persist) abort
  try
    execute 'colorscheme' fnameescape(a:name)
    let g:vimtutor_applied_theme = a:name
  catch /^Vim\%((\a\+)\)\=:E/
    echohl WarningMsg
    echom "vimtutor: colorscheme '" . a:name . "' unavailable"
          \ . " -- is it installed? (:PlugStatus)"
    echohl None
    return
  endtry
  if a:persist
    let l:path = s:tutor_home . '/config/vimrc.common'
    if filereadable(l:path)
      let l:lines = readfile(l:path)
      call map(l:lines, 'substitute(v:val, '
            \ . "'^\\\\s*let\\\\s*g:vimtutor_theme\\\\s*=\\\\s*.*$', "
            \ . "'let g:vimtutor_theme = \\\"' . a:name . '\\\"', '')')
      if !filewritable(l:path)
        echom 'vimtutor: cannot write ' . l:path . ' (read-only); theme set for this session only'
        return
      endif
      call writefile(l:lines, l:path)
    endif
  endif
endfunction

command! -nargs=1 -bar -bang Theme call s:VimtutorTheme(<q-args>, !empty('<bang>'))

" --- 4. plugins via vim-plug (managed in-editor) ------------------------------

" plug.vim is fetched by setup.sh into the tutor tree's autoload/.
if !exists('*plug#begin')
  echom 'vimtutor: vim-plug not found -- plugins are off.'
        \ ' Run setup.sh again, or see README (manual step: fetch plug.vim).'
else
  call plug#begin(g:vimtutor_plugdir)

  " Completion + LSP client: one engine for both editors. Needs Node 18+.
  Plug 'neoclide/coc.nvim', {'branch': 'release'}

  " Editor-grade syntax highlighting:
  if has('nvim')
    Plug 'nvim-treesitter/nvim-treesitter', {'do': ':TSUpdate'}
  else
    Plug 'sheerun/vim-polyglot'
  endif

  " Status line:
  if has('nvim')
    Plug 'nvim-lualine/lualine.nvim'
  else
    Plug 'vim-airline/vim-airline'
    " No powerline glyphs: readable on every stock terminal font.
    let g:airline_powerline_fonts = 0
  endif

  " Colorschemes (tokyonight is Neovim-only; gruvbox is universal).
  Plug 'morhetz/gruvbox'
  if has('nvim')
    Plug 'folke/tokyonight.nvim'
  endif

  " Editor quality-of-life (small, no config needed):
  Plug 'tpope/vim-fugitive'    " git: Lesson 11
  Plug 'tpope/vim-commentary'  " gcc to toggle comments
  Plug 'tpope/vim-surround'    " cs/ds/ys/S: Lesson 5
  Plug 'tpope/vim-sleuth'      " infer indentation from each file

  " Fuzzy finder -- only when its binaries are present.
  if executable('fzf')
    Plug 'junegunn/fzf'
    Plug 'junegunn/fzf.vim'
  endif

  call plug#end()

  " Friendly first-run nudge, exactly once.
  autocmd VimEnter * ++once
        \ if empty(globpath(g:vimtutor_plugdir, '*'))
        \ |   echom 'vimtutor: plugins not installed yet -- run :PlugInstall'
        \ | endif

  " Apply the default theme now that colorschemes are on the rtp.
  autocmd VimEnter * ++once call s:VimtutorTheme(g:vimtutor_theme, 0)
endif

" --- 5. per-plugin configuration ----------------------------------------------

" coc.nvim: completion, LSP, diagnostics (Lesson 12). Keymaps appear only
" when the plugin is actually installed, so Tab keeps working meanwhile.
if isdirectory(g:vimtutor_plugdir . '/coc.nvim')
  " Suggested extensions auto-installed at startup (needs node).
  if executable('node')
    let g:coc_global_extensions =
          \ get(g:, 'coc_global_extensions', ['coc-json', 'coc-tsserver'])
  endif

  " Navigation (Lesson 12)
  nmap <silent> gd <Plug>(coc-definition)
  nmap <silent> gy <Plug>(coc-type-definition)
  nmap <silent> gi <Plug>(coc-implementation)
  nmap <silent> gr <Plug>(coc-references)
  nmap <silent> [g <Plug>(coc-diagnostic-prev)
  nmap <silent> ]g <Plug>(coc-diagnostic-next)

  nnoremap <silent> K :call <SID>ShowDocumentation()<CR>
  function! s:ShowDocumentation() abort
    if CocAction('hasProvider', 'hover')
      call CocActionAsync('doHover')
    else
      execute '!' . &keywordprg . ' ' . expand('<cword>')
    endif
  endfunction

  " Refactor
  nmap <silent> <leader>rn <Plug>(coc-rename)
  nmap <silent> <leader>ac <Plug>(coc-codeaction-cursor)
  nmap <silent> <leader>qf <Plug>(coc-fix-current)
  xmap <silent> <leader>f  <Plug>(coc-format-selected)

  " Completion popup keys (coc#pum): Tab accepts, Shift-Tab steps back,
  " Ctrl-Space asks for completions.
  inoremap <silent><expr> <TAB>
        \ coc#pum#visible() ? coc#pum#confirm() : "\<Tab>"
  inoremap <silent><expr> <S-TAB>
        \ coc#pum#visible() ? coc#pum#prev(1) : "\<C-h>"
  inoremap <silent><expr> <c-space> coc#refresh()
endif

" treesitter (Neovim): highlight a practical language set.
if has('nvim') && isdirectory(g:vimtutor_plugdir . '/nvim-treesitter')
  lua << EOTS
  local ok, ts = pcall(require, 'nvim-treesitter.configs')
  if ok then
    ts.setup({
      ensure_installed = { 'bash', 'c', 'lua', 'markdown', 'markdown_inline',
                           'python', 'query', 'vim', 'vimdoc' },
      highlight = { enable = true },
      indent = { enable = true },
    })
  end
EOTS
endif

" lualine (Neovim status line) ships with sane defaults; just make it
" feel like the vim counterpart.
if has('nvim') && isdirectory(g:vimtutor_plugdir . '/lualine.nvim')
  lua << EOLUA
  local ok, lualine = pcall(require, 'lualine')
  if ok then
    lualine.setup({
      options = {
        icons_enabled = false,          -- no Nerd Font required
        section_separators = '',
        component_separators = '|',
      },
    })
  end
EOLUA
endif

" fzf (both editors, if the binary exists): files + content, fast.
if isdirectory(g:vimtutor_plugdir . '/fzf.vim')
  nnoremap <silent> <leader>ff :Files<CR>
  nnoremap <silent> <leader>fg :Rg<CR>
endif

" ============================================================================
"  Notes for hands-on readers (Lesson 9 is a guided tour of this file):
"  - :h options          every option explained in the built-in manual
"  - :options            browse all settings interactively
"  - :source $MYVIMRC    reload after editing
"  - :PlugInstall        install every :Plug line above
"  - :CocInstall coc-pyright   add a language server for your language
" ============================================================================

#   * system package installs are skipped (with the commands printed) rather
#     than guessed at when there is no passwordless sudo
#   * nothing is run inside your editor unless you pass --auto-install-plugins
#
# Usage: sh setup.sh [options]
#   --editor=both|vim|nvim   which editor to install/wire   (default: both)
#   --repo=URL_or_PATH       git URL (or local dir) of the tutor repo
#                            (default: $VIMTUTOR_REPO_URL, else the built-in
#                            URL below -- replace after forking!)
#   --home=DIR               install root  (default: $VIMTUTOR_HOME, else
#                            ~/.local/share/vimtutor)
#   --link                   dev helper: symlink a local --repo instead of copy
#   --with-tools             also install fzf + ripgrep when the pkg mgr has them
#   --no-pkg                 never touch system packages (print commands only)
#   --auto-install-plugins   run :PlugInstall --sync right now (network!)
#   --uninstall              remove the vimtutor blocks from your init files
#   --dry-run                print what would happen, change nothing
#   --help                   this text
# ============================================================================

set -eu
umask 022

REPO_URL_DEFAULT='https://github.com/YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME/vimtutor'
REPO_URL="${VIMTUTOR_REPO_URL:-$REPO_URL_DEFAULT}"
REPO_ARG=''
HOME_DIR="${VIMTUTOR_HOME:-}"
MODE='both'
WITH_TOOLS=0
NO_PKG=0
AUTO_PLUGINS=0
DRY_RUN=0
UNINSTALL=0
LINK=0

BEG='>>> vimtutor >>>'
END='<<< vimtutor <<<'

step()   { printf '== %s\n' "$*"; }
say()    { printf '   %s\n' "$*"; }
warn()   { printf '!! %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
die()    { warn "$*"; exit 1; }
run() {
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
    say "(dry-run) $*"
  else
    "$@"
  fi
}

usage() {
  sed -n '3,35p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'
  exit 0
}

# --- arguments ---------------------------------------------------------------

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --editor*) MODE="${1#--editor=}"; [ "$1" = "--editor" ] && { MODE="$2"; shift; } ;;
    --repo*)   REPO_ARG="${1#--repo=}";   [ "$1" = "--repo" ]   && { REPO_ARG="$2"; shift; } ;;
    --home*|--home*) HOME_DIR="${1#--home=}"; [ "$1" = "--home" ] && { HOME_DIR="$2"; shift; } ;;
    --link)   LINK=1 ;;
    --with-tools) WITH_TOOLS=1 ;;
    --no-pkg) NO_PKG=1 ;;
    --auto-install-plugins) AUTO_PLUGINS=1 ;;
    --uninstall) UNINSTALL=1 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    --help|-h) usage ;;
    *) die "unknown option: $1 (try --help)" ;;
  esac
  shift
done

case "$MODE" in both|vim|nvim) ;; *) die "--editor must be both|vim|nvim" ;; esac

# --- platform ------------------------------------------------------------

OS="$(uname -s)"
KERNEL_MGR=''
case "$OS" in
  Darwin) SYS=macos ;;
  Linux)  SYS=linux ;;
  *) SYS=other ;;
esac

PKG=''
for m in apt-get dnf yum zypper pacman apk brew; do
  if command -v "$m" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    case "$m" in
      apt-get) PKG=apt ;;
      *) PKG="$m" ;;
    esac
    break
  fi
done

# Passwordless privilege escalation, or none (we do NOT prompt in curl|sh).
SUDO=''
NO_PASSWORD=0
if [ "$(id -u)" = '0' ]; then
  SUDO=''
elif command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 && (sudo -n true 2>/dev/null); then
  SUDO='sudo'
else
  NO_PASSWORD=1
fi

pkg_install() {
  # pkg_install <pkg-manager> <name>...
  mgr="$1"; shift
  [ $# -eq 0 ] && return 0
  cmd_args=''
  case "$mgr" in
    apt)   cmd_args='env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y' ;;
    dnf|yum) cmd_args='install -y' ;;
    zypper) cmd_args='--non-interactive install' ;;
    pacman) cmd_args='-S --noconfirm' ;;
    apk)    cmd_args='add' ;;
    brew)   cmd_args='install' ;;
  esac
  case "$mgr" in
    apt|dnf|yum|zypper) prefix="$SUDO" ;;
    *) prefix='' ;;  # pacman/apk/brew: root via sudo only when already root
  esac
  if [ "$mgr" = 'pacman' ] && [ -n "$SUDO" ]; then prefix='sudo'; fi
  if [ "$mgr" = 'apk' ] && [ -n "$SUDO" ]; then prefix='sudo'; fi
  if [ "$mgr" != 'brew' ] && [ -z "$prefix" ] && [ "$NO_PASSWORD" -eq 1 ] && [ "$(id -u)" != '0' ] && [ "$mgr" != 'brew' ]; then
    warn "no passwordless root available; run manually: $mgr $cmd_args $*"
    MISSING_SYSTEM=1
    return 0
  fi
  if [ "$mgr" = 'brew' ]; then
    say "brew install $*"
    run brew install "$@"
  else
    say "$prefix $mgr $cmd_args $*"
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
      say "(dry-run) skipped"
    elif [ -n "$prefix" ]; then
      $prefix "$mgr" $cmd_args "$@"
    else
      "$mgr" $cmd_args "$@"
    fi
  fi
}

# per-manager package names
pkg_pkgs() {
  # pkg_pkgs <manager> <generic...>   (echoes real names)
  mgr="$1"; shift
  _out=''
  for p in "$@"; do
    n="$p"
    case "$mgr:$p" in
      *:vim) n='vim' ;;
      *:neovim) n='neovim' ;;
      *:node) n='nodejs' ;;
      *:fzf) n='fzf' ;;
      *:ripgrep) n='ripgrep' ;;
      *:curl) n='curl' ;;
      *:git) n='git' ;;
    esac
    case "$mgr:$p" in
      dnf:vim|yum:vim) n='vim-enhanced' ;;
      brew:node) n='node' ;;
      brew:ripgrep) n='ripgrep' ;;
    esac
    _out="$_out $n"
  done
  printf '%s' "$_out"
}

# --- uninstall ---------------------------------------------------------------

if [ "$UNINSTALL" -eq 1 ]; then
  if [ -z "$HOME_DIR" ]; then
    HOME_DIR="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/vimtutor"
  fi
  # Remove guarded blocks from every candidate init file.
  for f in "$HOME/.vimrc" "$HOME/.vim/vimrc" \
           "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/nvim/init.vim" \
           "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/nvim/init.lua"; do
    if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qF "$BEG" "$f"; then
      cp "$f" "$f.vimtutor-bak-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
      tmpf="$(mktemp)"
      awk "BEGIN{s=0} /$BEG/{s=1; next} /$END/{s=0; next} !s" "$f" > "$tmpf"
      mv "$tmpf" "$f"
      say "removed vimtutor block from $f (backup kept)"
    fi
  done
  if [ -f "$HOME_DIR/doc/tags" ]; then
    run rm -f "$HOME_DIR/doc/tags"
  fi
  say "uninstall done. To delete the clone+plugins entirely:"
  say "  rm -rf '$HOME_DIR'"
  say "Your original init file contents are in the *.vimtutor-bak-* files."
  exit 0
fi

# --- install root ------------------------------------------------------------

if [ -z "$HOME_DIR" ]; then
  HOME_DIR="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/vimtutor"
fi
step "install root: $HOME_DIR"
[ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ] && say "(dry-run) nothing below will actually run"

# --- system packages ---------------------------------------------------------

step "checking system dependencies"
have() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
MISSING_SYSTEM=0

if [ "$SYS" = 'linux' ] && [ -z "$PKG" ]; then
  warn "no known package manager found (apt/dnf/yum/zypper/pacman/apk)"
  say "install these by hand, then re-run with the editors present:"
  say "  git curl neovim (or vim) node"
  MISSING_SYSTEM=1
fi
if [ "$SYS" = 'macos' ] && [ -z "$PKG" ]; then
  warn "Homebrew not found; install it from https://brew.sh, then re-run"
  say "  brew install git curl neovim vim node"
  MISSING_SYSTEM=1
fi

if [ -n "$PKG" ] && [ "$NO_PKG" -eq 0 ]; then
  want=''
  case "$MODE" in
    both) want='neovim vim' ;;
    vim)  want='vim' ;;
    nvim) want='neovim' ;;
  esac
  # Base tools: need git+curl for the clone / plug.vim fetch.
  [ "$REPO_ARG" = "" ] && want="$want git curl"
  if [ "$WITH_TOOLS" -eq 1 ]; then want="$want fzf ripgrep"; fi

  todo=''
  for p in $want; do
    case "$p" in
      node) have node || todo="$todo node" ;;
      *) have "$p" || todo="$todo $p" ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ -n "$todo" ]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC2046
    pkg_install "$PKG" $(pkg_pkgs "$PKG" $todo)
  else
    say "all base packages already present"
  fi
else
  say "package installs skipped (managers/flags), continuing with what exists"
fi

# node quality check for coc.nvim: it needs >= 18 and refuses politely.
if have node; then
  node_major="$(node -e 'process.stdout.write(String(process.versions.node.split(".")[0]))' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  if [ "${node_major:-0}" -lt 18 ]; then
    warn "node $(node -v 2>/dev/null) found but coc.nvim needs >= 18;"
    say "completion will stay off until you update node, then re-run :PlugStatus"
  fi
else
  warn "node missing: coc.nvim (completion/LSP) cannot run without it."
  say "install node >= 18 (e.g. from nodejs.org or your distro), then re-run setup."
fi

# Editors present? (after installs)
VIM_BIN="$(command -v vim 2>/dev/null || true)"
NVIM_BIN="$(command -v nvim 2>/dev/null || true)"

case "$MODE" in
  vim)  [ -n "$VIM_BIN" ]  || die "vim not found and --editor=vim was requested" ;;
  nvim) [ -n "$NVIM_BIN" ] || die "neovim not found and --editor=nvim was requested" ;;
  both) [ -n "$VIM_BIN" ] || [ -n "$NVIM_BIN" ] || die "neither vim nor neovim found" ;;
esac

# Debian/Ubuntu's plain vim lacks some coc prerequisites; steer clearly.
if [ -n "$VIM_BIN" ]; then
  if ! "$VIM_BIN" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q '+channel'; then
    warn "your vim lacks +channel/+job; coc.nvim will not run in it."
    [ "$PKG" = 'apt' ] && say "consider: sudo apt install vim-gtk3 (this brings a full-featured /usr/bin/vim)"
  fi
  if ! "$VIM_BIN" --version 2>/dev/null | grep -q '+clipboard'; then
    say "note: your vim lacks +clipboard (system-clipboard registers)."
    say "      Debian/Ubuntu: vim-gtk3 package restores it; Neovim needs xclip/wl-clipboard."
  fi
fi

# --- fetch the tutor runtime ---------------------------------------------------

step "installing the tutor runtime tree"
needs_fetch=0
if [ ! -d "$HOME_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(ls -A "$HOME_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  needs_fetch=1
elif [ "$REPO_ARG" != '' ] && [ "$REPO_ARG" != "$HOME_DIR" ]; then
  needs_fetch=1
fi

fetch_from_local() {
  if [ ! -d "$REPO_ARG" ]; then die "--repo path '$REPO_ARG' is not a directory"; fi
  if [ -f "$REPO_ARG/plugin/vimtutor.vim" ]; then :; else
    die "--repo path '$REPO_ARG' does not look like the vimtutor repo"
  fi
  if [ "$LINK" -eq 1 ] && [ ! -e "$HOME_DIR" ]; then
    say "symlink $HOME_DIR -> $REPO_ARG"
    run ln -sfn "$REPO_ARG" "$HOME_DIR"
  else
    run cp -a "$REPO_ARG/." "$HOME_DIR/"
  fi
}

fetch_from_git() {
  if [ -e "$HOME_DIR" ] && [ -n "$(ls -A "$HOME_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    if [ -f "$HOME_DIR/plugin/vimtutor.vim" ]; then
      say "existing install found; updating with git (fast-forward only)"
      if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 0 ]; then
        ( cd "$HOME_DIR" && git fetch --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
          git reset --hard --quiet origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null || git pull --ff-only --quiet 2>/dev/null || true )
      else
        say "(dry-run) git update skipped"
      fi
    else
      die "$HOME_DIR exists but is not a vimtutor install; choose another with --home=..."
    fi
  else
    run git clone --depth=1 "$REPO_URL" "$HOME_DIR"
  fi
}

if [ "$needs_fetch" -eq 1 ]; then
  if [ "$REPO_ARG" != '' ]; then
    fetch_from_local
  else
    fetch_from_git
  fi
else
  say "existing install at $HOME_DIR, left as is"
fi
command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || warn "git not available; cloning skipped (use --repo with a local directory)"

# --- vim-plug bootstrap -------------------------------------------------------

step "fetching vim-plug (the in-editor plugin manager)"
mkdir -p "$HOME_DIR/autoload"
PLUG_TARGET="$HOME_DIR/autoload/plug.vim"
if [ -f "$PLUG_TARGET" ]; then
  say "plug.vim already present"
else
  if ! run curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --retry 2 \
        -o "$PLUG_TARGET" \
        'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/junegunn/vim-plug/HEAD/plug.vim'; then
    if [ ! -f "$PLUG_TARGET" ]; then
      warn "could not download plug.vim; plugins stay OFF until you re-run setup.sh"
    fi
  fi
fi

# --- wire editor configs -------------------------------------------------------

wire_vim_file() {  # wire_vim_file <path> <fresh>
  f="$1"
  if grep -qF "$BEG" "$f"; then
    say "already wired: $f"
    return 0
  fi
  if [ "$2" != 'fresh' ]; then
    cp "$f" "$f.vimtutor-bak-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
    say "backed up original to $(basename "$f").vimtutor-bak-*"
  fi
  tmpf="$(mktemp)"
  {
    sed "s|__VIMTUTOR_HOME__|$HOME_DIR|g" <<'VIMEOF'

" >>> vimtutor >>> (managed block; removed by setup.sh --uninstall)
let g:vimtutor_data = '__VIMTUTOR_HOME__'
if filereadable('__VIMTUTOR_HOME__/config/vimrc.common')
  source __VIMTUTOR_HOME__/config/vimrc.common
else
  echom 'vimtutor: missing __VIMTUTOR_HOME__ -- re-run setup.sh'
endif
" <<< vimtutor <<<
VIMEOF
  } >> "$tmpf"
  if [ "$2" != 'fresh' ]; then cat "$f" >> "$tmpf"; fi
  mv "$tmpf" "$f"
  say "wired: $f"
}

wire_lua_file() {  # wire_lua_file <path> <fresh>
  f="$1"
  if grep -qF "$BEG" "$f"; then
    say "already wired: $f"
    return 0
  fi
  if [ "$2" != 'fresh' ]; then
    cp "$f" "$f.vimtutor-bak-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
    say "backed up original to $(basename "$f").vimtutor-bak-*"
  fi
  tmpf="$(mktemp)"
  {
    sed "s|__VIMTUTOR_HOME__|$HOME_DIR|g" <<'LUAEOF'

-- >>> vimtutor >>> (managed block; removed by setup.sh --uninstall)
local vimtutor_ok = pcall(function()
  vim.cmd("let g:vimtutor_data = '__VIMTUTOR_HOME__'")
  vim.cmd("source __VIMTUTOR_HOME__/config/vimrc.common")
end)
if not vimtutor_ok then
  vim.notify("vimtutor: setup incomplete -- re-run setup.sh", vim.log.levels.WARN)
end
-- <<< vimtutor <<<
LUAEOF
  } >> "$tmpf"
  if [ "$2" != 'fresh' ]; then cat "$f" >> "$tmpf"; fi
  mv "$tmpf" "$f"
  say "wired: $f"
}

step "wiring editor init files"
VIMRC_WIRED=''
NVIMRC_WIRED=''

if [ -n "$VIM_BIN" ] || [ "$MODE" != 'nvim' ]; then
  if [ "$MODE" = 'vim' ] || [ "$MODE" = 'both' ]; then
    if [ -f "$HOME/.vimrc" ]; then
      wire_vim_file "$HOME/.vimrc" existing
    elif [ -f "$HOME/.vim/vimrc" ]; then
      wire_vim_file "$HOME/.vim/vimrc" existing
    else
      touch "$HOME/.vimrc"
      wire_vim_file "$HOME/.vimrc" fresh
    fi
    VIMRC_WIRED=1
  fi
fi

if [ "$MODE" = 'nvim' ] || [ "$MODE" = 'both' ]; then
  cfgdir="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/nvim"
  mkdir -p "$cfgdir"
  if [ -f "$cfgdir/init.lua" ]; then
    # Neovim reads init.lua INSTEAD of init.vim -- wire into the lua file.
    wire_lua_file "$cfgdir/init.lua" existing
    NVIMRC_WIRED="$cfgdir/init.lua"
  elif [ -f "$cfgdir/init.vim" ]; then
    wire_vim_file "$cfgdir/init.vim" existing
    NVIMRC_WIRED="$cfgdir/init.vim"
  else
    echo '" created by vimtutor setup.sh' > "$cfgdir/init.vim"
    wire_vim_file "$cfgdir/init.vim" existing
    NVIMRC_WIRED="$cfgdir/init.vim"
  fi
fi

# --- help tags ----------------------------------------------------------------

step "building help tags"
if [ -f "$NVIM_BIN" ]; then :; fi
if [ -n "$NVIM_BIN" ]; then
  run "$NVIM_BIN" --headless -u NONE "+helptags $HOME_DIR/doc" "+qa"
elif [ -n "$VIM_BIN" ]; then
  run "$VIM_BIN" -u NONE -N -es "+helptags $HOME_DIR/doc" +qa
fi

# --- optional: run the plugin install now --------------------------------------

if [ "$AUTO_PLUGINS" -eq 1 ]; then
  step "installing plugins headlessly (this can take a minute)"
  rcpath="$HOME/.vimrc"
  [ -f "$HOME/.vim/vimrc" ] && ! [ -f "$HOME/.vimrc" ] && rcpath="$HOME/.vim/vimrc"
  if [ -n "$NVIMRC_WIRED" ]; then rcpath="$NVIMRC_WIRED"; fi
  if [ "$SYS" != 'macos' ] && command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    PREF='timeout 900'; else PREF=''; fi
  if [ -n "$NVIM_BIN" ]; then
    EDITOR_BIN="$NVIM_BIN"
  elif [ -n "$VIM_BIN" ]; then
    EDITOR_BIN="$VIM_BIN"
  fi
  say "running: $PREF $EDITOR_BIN -u $rcpath +PlugInstall"
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 0 ]; then
    $PREF "$EDITOR_BIN" -u "$rcpath" \
      "+silent! PlugInstall --sync" "+qa" || warn "plugin install had trouble; re-run :PlugInstall manually"
    # a second launch lets coc bootstrap its extensions (needs node)
    if have node; then
      say "bootstrapping coc extensions"
      $PREF "$EDITOR_BIN" -u "$rcpath" "+qa" || true
    fi
  fi
fi

# --- summary -------------------------------------------------------------------

step "done"
say "config wired:"
[ -n "$VIMRC_WIRED" ] && { [ -f "$HOME/.vimrc" ] && say "  vim:    $HOME/.vimrc" || say "  vim:    $HOME/.vim/vimrc"; }
[ -n "$NVIMRC_WIRED" ] && say "  neovim: $NVIMRC_WIRED"
if [ "$MISSING_SYSTEM" -eq 1 ]; then
  warn "some system packages were NOT installed (see the !! lines above)."
  say "install them, then re-run setup.sh --editor=$MODE to finish."
fi
say "next steps:"
[ "$AUTO_PLUGINS" -eq 0 ] && say "  1. open your editor and run  :PlugInstall"
say "  $([ "$AUTO_PLUGINS" -eq 1 ] && echo 2 || echo 1). language servers you want:"
say "       :CocInstall coc-json coc-tsserver      (js/ts; json)"
say "       :CocInstall coc-pyright coc-clangd     (python; c/c++)"
say "  $([ "$AUTO_PLUGINS" -eq 1 ] && echo 3 || echo 2). start:  :Tutor"
exit 0

  if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 0 ]; then

    say "tar copy into $HOME_DIR (working tree, without .git)"

input.content:
# VIMTUTOR ADVANCED

An advanced, modern remake of the classic `vimtutor` — same tilde-bordered,
learn-by-editing format you remember, but teaching the serious stuff: split
windows, the buffer/window/tab model, registers, macros, text objects,
quickfix, folds, marks, a fully configured editor (`coc.nvim` completion and
LSP, syntax highlighting, status line, colorschemes, git) — and it works
identically in **Vim 9+** and **Neovim 0.10+**.

Everything is learned interactively: every lesson opens as a **scratch copy**
(exactly like the original tutor), so you edit the real thing and throw your
practice changes away by exiting with `:q!`.

**Prerequisite:** you already know the basics (`h j k l`, `i a o`, `x dd u`,
`/pattern`, `:w :q`). If not, run the classic `vimtutor` once first.

## Quick start (`curl | sh`)

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME/vimtutor/main/setup.sh | sh
```

Then in your editor:

```vim
:PlugInstall     " once, to install the plugins
:Tutor           " start at the table of contents
```

> The `YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME` placeholder should be the repo's real location
> (replace it after pushing this repository — see "For developers" below).

## What `setup.sh` does (and deliberately does not do)

Runs on Linux (apt, dnf/yum, zypper, pacman, apk) and macOS (Homebrew):

1. **Installs missing system packages** — `neovim` and/or `vim` (your choice,
   default both), plus `git`/`curl`. Skipped gracefully — with the exact
   commands printed for you to run — when there is no passwordless root
   (`sudo -n`). Opt in `fzf` + `ripgrep` with `--with-tools`.
2. **Checks Node.js** (≥ 18) — `coc.nvim` needs it; you get a pointed warning
   either way (no surprise third-party repositories are ever added).
3. **Installs the tutor runtime** into `~/.local/share/vimtutor` (override
   with `--home=` or `$VIMTUTOR_HOME`) — the lessons, the plugin, the shared
   configuration. Nothing outside that directory plus your init file changes.
4. **Downloads `plug.vim`** (vim-plug) so plugin management stays **in the
   editor** — `:PlugInstall` / `:PlugUpdate` / `:PlugClean`, no shell scripts.
5. **Wires your init file** — prepends a marker-guarded block to
   `~/.vimrc` (or `~/.vim/vimrc`) and to Neovim's
   `~/.config/nvim/init.vim` **or** `init.lua` (whichever exists; block goes
   in front of your code so user overrides always win). It never overwrites:
   originals are backed up next to the file as `*.vimtutor-bak-*.`.
6. **Builds the help tags** so `:help vimtutor` works.
7. Prints next steps. It does **not** launch your editor or touch plugins
   unless you pass `--auto-install-plugins`.

The block it appends looks like this and is idempotent — re-running
`setup.sh` is always safe:

```vim
" >>> vimtutor >>> (managed block; removed by setup.sh --uninstall)
let g:vimtutor_data = '~/.local/share/vimtutor'
if filereadable('~/.local/share/vimtutor/config/vimrc.common')
  source ~/.local/share/vimtutor/config/vimrc.common
else
  echom 'vimtutor: missing ~/.local/share/vimtutor -- re-run setup.sh'
endif
" <<< vimtutor <<<
```

### Flags

| Flag | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| `--editor=both\|vim\|nvim` | which editor(s) to install/wire (default: both) |
| `--repo=URL_or_DIR` | install from this git URL or local checkout instead |
| `--home=DIR` | install root (default `~/.local/share/vimtutor`) |
| `--link` | dev helper: symlink a local `--repo` instead of copying |
| `--refresh` | re-copy an existing local `--repo` install (deletes it first) |
| `--with-tools` | also install `fzf` + `ripgrep` when available |
| `--no-pkg` | never touch system packages, print commands instead |
| `--auto-install-plugins` | run `:PlugInstall --sync` headlessly right now |
| `--uninstall` | remove both managed blocks (keeps backups + the clone; it prints one `rm -rf` for that) |

## Manual install (no `curl | sh`)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME/vimtutor.git
cd vimtutor
sh setup.sh --repo "$(pwd)"          # everything, from the local checkout
# or just print the plan first:
sh setup.sh --repo "$(pwd)" --dry-run
```

Fully manual wiring, if you would rather not run the script: clone the repo
anywhere, make sure `set runtimepath^=/path/to/vimtutor` lands early in your
init file (before plugin loading), then source `config/vimrc.common`:

```vim
set runtimepath^=~/.local/share/vimtutor
let g:vimtutor_data = '~/.local/share/vimtutor'
source ~/.local/share/vimtutor/config/vimrc.common
```

## Using the tutor

```vim
:Tutor            " table of contents (press <Enter> on a |01| entry)
:Tutor 3          " jump straight to lesson 3 (accepts 03 too)
:Tutor splits     " or any name fragment; Tab completes
:TutorClassic     " the stock markdown tutorial that ships with the editor
:help vimtutor    " the reference
```

| # | Lesson |
|---|--------|
| 01 | Windows and splits |
| 02 | Buffers and tabs — the mental model |
| 03 | Registers beyond basics (`"0`, named, blackhole, clipboards) |
| 04 | Macros: recorded power |
| 05 | Visual modes and text objects (incl. block mode, surround) |
| 06 | Search, `:s` flags, very magic, `:global`, quickfix across files |
| 07 | Marks and the jumplist (plus the `q:` command window) |
| 08 | Folds |
| 09 | Your config: mappings, plugins, colorschemes (guided tour) |
| 10 | Files, `:args`, sessions, netrw |
| 11 | Terminals (`:term`) and git (fugitive) |
| 12 | Completion and LSP with `coc.nvim` |
| 13 | Cheat sheet: everything on one page |

Lessons are single files under `lessons/`; the scratch copies (including
`lessons/demo/*.js|.c|.py` practice targets) live in a temp folder per
session, and the lesson window's working directory is that folder, so
`:e`, `:find`, `:vimgrep **/*`, and netrw all operate inside the sandbox.

## The configuration that ships

`config/vimrc.common` is the single source shared by both editors. It degrades
gracefully: **all plugin blocks are guarded**, so before `:PlugInstall` you
get a clean, sane vanilla editor, and afterward the full experience.

| Feature | Vim 9 | Neovim 0.10 |
|---|---|---|
| completion + LSP | coc.nvim | coc.nvim *(same keys)* |
| syntax highlighting | vim-polyglot | nvim-treesitter |
| status line | vim-airline | lualine.nvim |
| colorschemes | gruvbox | gruvbox + tokyonight |
| git | fugitive | fugitive |
| fuzzy finder | fzf.vim (if `fzf` binary) | fzf.vim (if `fzf` binary) |
| small QoL | commentary, surround, sleuth | same |

Opinionated defaults worth knowing (change them in `~/.local/share/vimtutor/config/vimrc.common`
or, better, override in your init file, which is sourced first for
Neovim/after for Vim — your file always wins):

- `<leader>` is the **space bar**; `<space>w` writes, `<space>v`/`<space>s`
  split, `<space>t` tab-new, `<space>bl` `:ls`, `<space>h` clears search, …
- `hidden`, `splitbelow splitright`, `number relativenumber`, `scrolloff=8`,
  `ignorecase smartcase`, `wildmenu`, `path+=**`, persistent undo.
- coc keys (when coc is installed): `gd gy gi gr`, `[g ]g`, `K`,
  `<leader>rn` rename, `<leader>ac` code action, `<leader>qf` quickfix,
  `<leader>f` format selection; Tab accepts completions, `Ctrl-Space` triggers.
- `:Theme gruvbox` switches colorschemes (`:Theme name!` persists the choice
  by rewriting the default inside the shared config).
- The system clipboard is deliberately **not** merged with `"` — lesson 03
  explains the tradeoff and how to flip it (`:set clipboard=unnamed`).

## Vim vs Neovim notes

- The tutor behaves identically in both. It shadows the built-in `:Tutor`
  command on purpose; `:TutorClassic` gets you the editor's stock interactive
  tutorial back.
- Neovim needs nothing extra for the `+`/`*` registers beyond a provider
  (`xclip`, `wl-clipboard`, `pbcopy`) — run `:checkhealth` to see. Vim needs a
  build **with** `+clipboard`: Debian/Ubuntu's default `vim` package lacks it;
  `sudo apt install vim-gtk3` fixes both that and `:term` niceties. `setup.sh`
  prints this for you if it detects the deficiency.
- `nvim-treesitter` builds parsers at install time, so have a C compiler
  (`gcc`/`clang`) around on Neovim — the polyglot path on Vim needs none.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| `:Tutor` says no lessons found | the install tree moved — re-run `setup.sh` (it only rewrites its managed block) |
| no completion menus in lesson 12 | `:CocInfo` + node ≥ 18? then `:CocInstall coc-tsserver` |
| vim `E319`/feature complaints from coc | your vim lacks `+channel` — switch to Neovim or a fuller vim build (`vim-gtk3`) |
| colors look wrong over SSH | `export COLORTERM=truecolor` before launching, or pick gruvbox |
| want the old tutor exactly | `:TutorClassic` here, or plain `vimtutor` in a shell |

## For developers

- Lesson content is plain text in `lessons/`; the tutor format is the classic
  `~`-bordered style with `--->` practice targets. Run `sh test/run.sh` after
  any content or plugin change — it executes the headless smoke suite under
  both editors plus lesson integrity checks (link table, line widths, tabs).
- `setup.sh` is POSIX `sh`, `shellcheck`-clean, and fully tested in an
  isolated `HOME` (`test/config_check.sh`).
- Before publishing, replace `YOUR-GITHUB-USERNAME` in `setup.sh` (one
  constant) and in the README, push, and the `curl -fsSL .../setup.sh | sh`
  one-liner above becomes live.

## License

MIT — same spirit as (nothing to do with, but inspired by) the original vim
tutorial.

DESCRIPTION
  OpenCode command line interface

USAGE
  opencode <subcommand> [flags] [<directory>]

ARGUMENTS
  directory string    Directory to start OpenCode in (optional)

FLAGS
  --standalone            Run with a private server instead of the background service
  --server string         Connect to a server URL instead of the background service
  --auto                  Auto-approve permissions that are not explicitly denied
  --continue, -c          Continue the last session
  --session, -s string    Session ID to continue, or to create if it does not exist
  --prompt string         Prompt to use

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|powershell|sh|pwsh>                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, powershell, sh, pwsh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)
  --print-logs                                                        Print logs to stderr (server logs require --standalone)

SUBCOMMANDS
  upgrade, update    Upgrade OpenCode to the latest or a specific version
  uninstall          Uninstall OpenCode, keeping session data, configuration, and state
  acp                Start an Agent Client Protocol server
  api                Make a request to the running server
  debug              Debugging and troubleshooting tools
  auth               manage integrations and credentials
  mcp                Manage MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers
  plugin             Manage plugins
  models             List all available models
  stats              Show shareable usage statistics
  mini               Start the minimal interactive interface
  run                Run OpenCode with a message

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""export-agent-log -- commit-friendly export of the opencode session log.

Pulls the full interactive history (user prompts, assistant replies, model
reasoning, and every tool call with its input/output) for sessions belonging
to this project from opencode, and renders two artifacts per session:

    agentlog/sessions/<session-id>.md      human-readable narrative
    agentlog/sessions/<session-id>.jsonl   one verbatim JSON per message

plus a regenerated index at agentlog/README.md.

Data flow:
    discovery : the opencode SQLite store (read-only) finds sessions by
                project directory prefix, including subagent children
                (session_v2 table). Falls back to `opencode session list`
                when the database is unreadable.
    content   : `opencode session export <session-id>` -- the official CLI
                (talks to the running background service). No DB schema
                coupling for content.

Contract used by .githooks/pre-commit and AGENTS.md:
    exit 0  success (files written, or nothing to do)
    exit 4  opencode is not installed/running in this environment
            (hook may skip quietly; other error codes fail hard)

The output is deterministic (no wall-clock stamps), so re-running this
script only produces diffs when the transcript actually grew. The log is
VERBATIM: never paste secrets into a session that will be committed by
this tool.

Usage:
    scripts/export-agent-log [--output DIR] [--project DIR] [--quiet]
Env:
    AGENTLOG_MD_MAX    cap per fenced block in .md rendering (0 = no cap;
                       default 3000; full text always stays in .jsonl)
    AGENTLOG_JSONL_MAX cap per message JSON line in bytes (0 = full;
                       default 0)
"""

import json
import os
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

SCHEMA = "opencode-agentlog/1"
GENERATOR = "scripts/export-agent-log"
DEFAULT_OUT = "agentlog"
DEFAULT_MD_MAX = 3000
DEFAULT_JSONL_MAX = 0

EXIT_OK = 0
EXIT_ERROR = 1
EXIT_NO_OPENCODE = 4


def log(msg, quiet=False):
    if not quiet:
        print(f"[agentlog] {msg}", file=sys.stderr)


def die(msg, code=EXIT_ERROR):
    print(f"[agentlog] {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(code)


def find_opencode():
    here = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".opencode", "bin", "opencode")
    for cand in (here, "/usr/local/bin/opencode"):
        if os.path.isfile(cand) and os.access(cand, os.X_OK):
            return cand
    return None


def iso(ms):
    if not isinstance(ms, (int, float)) or ms <= 0:
        return "?"
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000.0, tz=timezone.utc).strftime(
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ"
    )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# discovery
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def discover_via_db(opencode_home, project_dir):
    """Return [{id, parent_id, slug, title, time_created, directory}] from
    session_v2 (sessions whose directory starts with the project dir),
    including subagent children. Read-only; never writes."""
    rows = []
    db = os.path.join(opencode_home, "opencode.db")
    if not os.path.isfile(db):
        return rows
    try:
        con = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{db}?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=5)
        cur = con.cursor()
        like = project_dir.rstrip("/") + "%"
        children_of = [project_dir]
        # BFS down the child chain by directory prefix.
        seen = {}
        for depth in range(8):  # safety depth
            placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(children_of))
            parents = ",".join("?" * len(children_of))
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT id, parent_id, slug, title, time_created, directory "
                "FROM session_v2 "
                "WHERE directory LIKE ? OR parent_id IN (" + parents + ") "
                "ORDER BY time_created",
                (like, *children_of),
            )
            new = []
            for rid, pid, slug, title, tc, directory in cur.fetchall():
                if rid not in seen:
                    seen[rid] = True
                    new.append(
                        {
                            "id": rid,
                            "parent_id": pid,
                            "slug": slug,
                            "title": title,
                            "time_created": tc,
                            "directory": directory,
                        }
                    )
            if not new:
                break
            rows.extend(new)
            children_of = [r["id"] for r in new]
        con.close()
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 -- degrade to CLI discovery
        log(f"sqlite discovery unavailable ({exc}); using CLI fallback")
        return []
    return rows


def discover_via_cli(opencode_bin):
    """Fallback: parse `opencode session list` (runs against the service
    for the CURRENT working directory)."""
    rows = []
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            [opencode_bin, "session", "list"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, check=False,
        ).stdout
        for line in out.splitlines():
            bits = line.split("\t")
            if bits and bits[0].startswith("ses_"):
                rows.append(
                    {"id": bits[0], "parent_id": None, "slug": "",
                     "title": bits[1] if len(bits) > 1 else "",
                     "time_created": 0, "directory": os.getcwd()}
                )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        log(f"CLI discovery failed: {exc}")
    return rows


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# content
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def export_session(opencode_bin, session_id):
    """Via the official CLI (service must be running). Returns the parsed
    export payload: {'info': {...}, 'messages': [...]}."""
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [opencode_bin, "session", "export", session_id],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300, check=False,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"export exited {proc.returncode}: {proc.stderr.strip()[:300]}"
        )
    return json.loads(proc.stdout)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# rendering
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def truncate(text, limit):
    if not isinstance(text, str) or limit <= 0 or len(text) <= limit:
        return text, False
    return (
        text[:limit] + f"\n\n[... truncated: {limit} of {len(text)} chars; "
        "full text is in the matching .jsonl file]",
        True,
    )


def fence(text, lang=""):
    return f"```{lang}\n{text}\n```"


def render_tool_block_md(session_base, tool, md_max):
    name = tool.get("name", "?")
    state = tool.get("state") or {}
    status = state.get("status", "unknown")
    lines = [f"#### Tool `{name}` — `{status}`"]

    meta = state.get("metadata") or {}
    extras = {}
    for key in ("exit", "truncated"):
        if key in meta:
            extras[key] = meta[key]
    tool_id = tool.get("id", "")
    if tool_id:
        lines.append(f"_call id: `{tool_id}`" + (f" — {extras}}" if False else ""))
    if extras:
        pretty = ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in extras.items())
        lines.append(f"_extras: {pretty}_")

    inp = state.get("input")
    if inp is not None:
        body, _ = truncate(json.dumps(inp, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), md_max)
        lines.append("**Input**")
        lines.append(fence(body, "json"))

    content = state.get("content") or []
    if isinstance(content, list):
        for i, item in enumerate(content):
            text = item.get("text", "") if isinstance(item, dict) else str(item)
            label = "Output" if len(content) == 1 else f"Output part {i + 1}"
            body, truncated = truncate(text, md_max)
            lines.append(f"**{label}**" + (" _(see note below)_" if truncated else ""))
            lines.append(fence(body))
    elif isinstance(content, str) and content:
        body, truncated = truncate(content, md_max)
        lines.append("**Output**")
        lines.append(fence(body))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def render_message_md(msg, idx, session_id, md_max):
    mtype = msg.get("type", "unknown")
    time_created = (msg.get("time") or {}).get("created")
    head = f"## {idx}. {mtype.upper()} — {iso(time_created)}"

    extras = []
    if mtype == "assistant":
        model = msg.get("model") or {}
        extras.append(
            f"model `{model.get('providerID', '?')}/{model.get('id', '?')}`"
        )
        extras.append(f"agent `{msg.get('agent', 'build')}`")
        if msg.get("cost") is not None:
            extras.append(f"cost ${msg.get('cost'):.6f}")
        toks = msg.get("tokens") or {}
        if toks:
            extras.append(
                "tokens "
                f"in={toks.get('input', '?')} out={toks.get('output', '?')}"
            )
        extras.append(f"finish `{msg.get('finish', '?')}`")
    head_line = head + (f"  <!-- {'; '.join(extras)} -->" if extras else "")

    out = [head_line]
    if extras:
        out.append("_" + "; ".join(extras) + "_")

    if mtype == "user":
        text = msg.get("text", "")
        if text:
            out.append("")
            out.append(text)
        files = msg.get("files")
        if files:

        if agents:
            body, _ = truncate(json.dumps(agents, ensure_ascii=False), md_max)
            out.append("")
            out.append(f"> agents: {body}")
        return "\n".join(out)

    if mtype in ("synthetic", "idle"):
        detail = json.dumps(
            {k: v for k, v in msg.items() if k not in ("id", "time", "type")},
            ensure_ascii=False,
        )
        body, _ = truncate(detail, 500)
        out.append("")
        out.append(f"> session event: {body}")
        return "\n".join(out)

    # assistant
    for block in msg.get("content") or []:
        btype = block.get("type")
        if btype == "reasoning":
            text = block.get("text", "")
            if not text.strip():
                continue
            out.append("")
            out.append("### Model reasoning")
            out.append("")
            out.append(text)
        elif btype == "tool":
            out.append("")
            out.append(render_tool_block_md(session_id, block, md_max))
        elif btype == "text":
            text = block.get("text", "")
            if text.strip():
                out.append("")
                out.append("### Reply")
                out.append("")
                out.append(text)
        else:
            detail = json.dumps(block, ensure_ascii=False)
            body, _ = truncate(detail, 500)
            out.append("")
            out.append(f"### {btype or 'unknown'} block")
            out.append(fence(body, "json"))
    return "\n".join(out)


def render_session_md(info, messages, md_max):
    model = info.get("model") or {}
    tokens = info.get("tokens") or {}
    cache = tokens.get("cache") or {}
    lines = [
        f"# {info.get('title') or 'Untitled session'}",
        "",
        f"- session: `{info.get('id')}`",
        f"- project dir: `{info.get('location', {}).get('path') if isinstance(info.get('location'), dict) else info.get('location', '?')}`",
        f"- started: {iso((info.get('time') or {}).get('created'))}"
        f" · last activity: {iso((info.get('time') or {}).get('updated'))}",
        f"- model: `{model.get('providerID', '?')}/{model.get('id', '?')}`"
        f" · agent: `{info.get('agent', '?')}`",
        "- tokens: "
        f"in={tokens.get('input', 0)} out={tokens.get('output', 0)} "
        f"reasoning={tokens.get('reasoning', 0)} "
        f"cache r={cache.get('read', 0)}/w={cache.get('write', 0)}"
        f" · cost: ${info.get('cost', 0):.4f}"
        f" · outcome: `{info.get('outcome', '?')}`",
        "- messages: " + str(len(messages)),
        "",
        "Rendered by `scripts/export-agent-log` from `opencode session export`."
        " Tool outputs are capped for readability; the full fidelity data"
        " (every input and byte of output) is in the paired `.jsonl` file.",
        "",
        "---",
        "",
    ]
    n_user = sum(1 for m in messages if m.get("type") == "user")
    n_assistant = sum(1 for m in messages if m.get("type") == "assistant")
    lines.append(
        f"_{n_user} user prompts, {n_assistant} assistant"
        f" turns, {len(messages)} messages total (incl. events)._"
    )
    lines.append("")

    for i, msg in enumerate(messages, 1):
        lines.append(render_message_md(msg, i, info.get("id", ""), md_max))
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"


def render_jsonl(info, messages, session_id, project_dir, jsonl_max):
    meta = {
        "_type": "session-log-meta",
        "format": SCHEMA,
        "generator": GENERATOR,
        "source": "opencode session export",
        "session_id": session_id,
        "project_dir": project_dir,
        "messages": len(messages),
        "session_info": info,
    }
    lines = [json.dumps(meta, ensure_ascii=False)]
    for msg in messages:
        line = json.dumps(msg, ensure_ascii=False)
        if jsonl_max and len(line) > jsonl_max:
            blob = {
                "_type": "truncated-message",
                "id": msg.get("id"),
                "type": msg.get("type"),
                "original_bytes": len(line.encode("utf-8")),
                "note": (
                    "set AGENTLOG_JSONL_MAX=0 for full fidelity; "
                    "the .md sibling carries a readable rendition"
                ),
            }
            line = json.dumps(blob, ensure_ascii=False)
        lines.append(line)
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def render_index(entries):
    rows = []
    for e in sorted(entries, key=lambda x: (x["time_created"] or 0, x["id"])):
        rows.append(
            f"| [`{e['id']}`](sessions/{e['id']}.md) "
            f"| {e.get('title') or '(no title)'} "
            f"| {iso(e['time_created'])} "
            f"| {e['messages']} "
            f"| {e.get('directory', '')} |"
        )
    return "\n".join(
        [
            "# Agent session log (generated)",
            "",
            "Verbatim log of the agentic sessions run in this repository:",
            "user prompts, model reasoning, and every tool call with its"
            " input/output. Generated by `scripts/export-agent-log` from"
            " `opencode session export`; refreshed automatically by the"
            " pre-commit hook. See `AGENTS.md` for the rule.",
            "",
            "**Do not edit files in this directory by hand** -- regenerate"
            " instead:",
            "",
            "    scripts/export-agent-log",
            "",
            "Per session you get a readable `.md` (tool outputs capped at"
            " `AGENTLOG_MD_MAX`, default 3000 chars) and a `.jsonl` sibling"
            " with full fidelity (cap the JSONL itself with"
            " `AGENTLOG_JSONL_MAX`, default: no cap). Output is"
            " deterministic: unchanged transcripts produce no diffs.",
            "",
            "The log is verbatim -- never paste secrets in a session that"
            " this tool will commit.",
            "",
            "| session | title | started | messages | directory |",
            "|---|---|---|---|---|",
            *rows,
            "",
        ]
    )


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# main
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main(argv):
    quiet = "--quiet" in argv
    project_dir = os.path.abspath(os.getcwd())
    out_dir = os.path.join(project_dir, DEFAULT_OUT)
    if "--output" in argv:
        out_dir = os.path.abspath(argv[argv.index("--output") + 1])
    elif "--project" in argv:
        project_dir = os.path.abspath(argv[argv.index("--project") + 1])
        out_dir = os.path.join(project_dir, DEFAULT_OUT)
    elif os.path.isdir(os.path.join(project_dir, "agentlog")):
        out_dir = os.path.join(project_dir, "agentlog")

    md_max = int(os.environ.get("AGENTLOG_MD_MAX", DEFAULT_MD_MAX))
    jsonl_max = int(os.environ.get("AGENTLOG_JSONL_MAX", DEFAULT_JSONL_MAX))

    opencode_bin = find_opencode()
    if not opencode_bin and os.path.isfile(" ~/.opencode/bin/opencode"):
        opencode_bin = " ~/.opencode/bin/opencode"
    if not opencode_bin:
        die("opencode not installed in this environment; nothing to export",
            EXIT_NO_OPENCODE)

    opencode_home = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(opencode_bin))
    if os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(opencode_bin)) == "bin":
        opencode_home = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(opencode_bin))

    sessions = discover_via_db(opencode_home, project_dir)
    if not sessions:
        sessions = discover_via_cli(opencode_bin)
    if not sessions:
        log(f"no opencode sessions found for {project_dir}; nothing to export")
        return EXIT_OK

    # The DB and the CLI may disagree about which sessions exist right now
    # (brand-new sessions appear server-side first). Export CLI-side ids
    # too via the list, minus duplicates.
    known = {s["id"] for s in sessions}
    for s in discover_via_cli(opencode_bin):
        if s["id"] not in known:
            sessions.append(s)
            known.add(s["id"])

    sessions.sort(key=lambda s: (s.get("time_created") or 0, s["id"]))

    sessions_dir = os.path.join(out_dir, "sessions")
    os.makedirs(sessions_dir, exist_ok=True)

    index_entries = []
    for s in sessions:
        sid = s["id"]
        payload = export_session(opencode_bin, sid)
        info = payload.get("info") or {}
        messages = payload.get("messages") or []

        md = render_session_md(info, messages, md_max)
        jsonl = render_jsonl(info, messages, sid, project_dir, jsonl_max)

        with open(os.path.join(sessions_dir, f"{sid}.md"), "w") as fh:
            fh.write(md)
        with open(os.path.join(sessions_dir, f"{sid}.jsonl"), "w") as fh:
            fh.write(jsonl)

        index_entries.append(
            {
                "id": sid,
                "title": info.get("title") or s.get("title"),
                "time_created": info.get("time", {}).get("created")
                or s.get("time_created"),
                "messages": len(messages),
                "directory": info.get("location", {}).get("path")
                if isinstance(info.get("location"), dict)
                else s.get("directory", ""),
            }
        )
        log(
            f"exported {sid}: {len(messages)} messages "
            f"({info.get('title') or s.get('title')})",
            quiet,
        )

    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, "README.md"), "w") as fh:
        fh.write(render_index(index_entries))

    # remove artifacts for sessions that no longer exist server-side
    valid_files = {
        f"{e['id']}.md" for e in index_entries
    } | {f"{e['id']}.jsonl" for e in index_entries}
    stale = [
        f for f in os.listdir(sessions_dir)
        if f.endswith((".md", ".jsonl")) and f not in valid_files
    ]
    for f in stale:
        os.remove(os.path.join(sessions_dir, f))
        log(f"removed stale artifact {f}", quiet)

    if not quiet:
        total = sum(
            os.path.getsize(os.path.join(sessions_dir, f))
            for f in os.listdir(sessions_dir)
        )
        log(f"agent log up to date: {len(index_entries)} session(s), {total} bytes")
    return EXIT_OK


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        die(str(exc))
    except subprocess.SubprocessError as exc:
        die(f"opencode is not reachable ({exc}); is the background service"
            f" running? -- `opencode service status`")
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        die(f"could not parse export payload: {exc}")

# AGENTS.md — project rules for agents working in this repository

Applies to any AI agent (opencode, Claude, ...) or human making changes here.
Read together with the global rules in `~/.agents/` and `README.md`.

## Agent session log — refresh on EVERY commit (mandatory)

This repository preserves its full agentic development history: user
prompts, the model's reasoning, and every tool call with input/output.
The log lives in `agentlog/` and is committed to the repo.

### The rule

1. **Before every `git commit`, run:**

   ```sh
   scripts/export-agent-log
   ```

2. **If `agentlog/` changed, include it in the same commit**
   (`git add -A agentlog`). Prefer folding the log update into the commit
   it documents over a separate `chore:` commit.

3. A git **pre-commit hook does this automatically** (`core.hooksPath` is
   set to `.githooks/` in this repo). The hook refreshes the log, stages
   changes, and **fails the commit** if the opencode service is unreachable:
   fix the cause (`opencode service restart`) and retry. Never skip,
   disable, or bypass this hook; never use `--no-verify`.

### Working with the log

- **Never hand-edit anything under `agentlog/`.** It is generated data;
  regenerate with the script instead. Merge requests should not show
  manual patches to these files.
- Output is **deterministic**: unchanged transcripts produce no diff, and
  new activity only ever appends. Diffs on `agentlog/` should therefore be
  pure additions; investigate anything else.
- The `.jsonl` files are **full fidelity** (every tool input and byte of
  output); the `.md` files are the reviewable rendition, with tool outputs
  capped (`AGENTLOG_MD_MAX`, default 3000 chars; `0` disables).
- Sessions include subagent sessions (children), listed in the log index.
- The log is **verbatim**: do not paste secrets, tokens, or credentials
  into a session — they will be committed verbatim by this tool.
- If a session was compacted or reverted in opencode, the regenerated log
  reflects the stored transcript state; stale artifacts for sessions that
  no longer exist server-side are removed by the script.

### How it works (for maintenance)

- Discovery: read-only query on opencode's SQLite store
  (`$XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode/opencode.db`, `session_v2` by directory
  prefix, BFS through subagent children); falls back to
  `opencode session list`.
- Content: `opencode session export <id>` (official CLI, talks to the
  running background service) — this is why the service must be up.
- Exit codes: `0` success, `4` opencode not installed in this environment
  (hook skips quietly), anything else is an error (hook fails the commit).

 # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# redaction (personal strings never leave the machine)
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def load_redactions(path):
+    """Parse `REGEX :: REPLACEMENT` lines ('#' comments). Returns
+    [(compiled_regex, replacement), ...] in file order."""
+    rules = []
+    if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
+        return rules
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        for lineno, raw in enumerate(fh, 1):
+            line = raw.strip()
+            if not line or line.startswith("#"):
+                continue
+            if "::" not in line:
+                log(f"{os.path.basename(path)}:{lineno}: missing ' :: ' "
+                    "separator, line ignored")
+                continue
+            pattern, repl = line.split("::", 1)
+            try:
+                rules.append((re.compile(pattern.strip()), repl.rstrip("\n")))
+            except re.error as exc:
+                log(f"{os.path.basename(path)}:{lineno}: bad pattern "
+                    f"({exc}); line ignored")
+    return rules
+
+
+def scrubber(rules):
+    """Factory: returns scrub(text) applying all rules in order."""
+    def scrub(text):
+        if not isinstance(text, str) or not rules:
+            return text
+        for pattern, repl in rules:
+            text = pattern.sub(repl, text)
+        return text
+    return scrub
+
+
+def find_redactions(repo_root):
+    for cand in (
+        os.environ.get("AGENTLOG_REDACTIONS"),
+        os.path.join(repo_root, REDACTIONS_NAME),
+    ):
+        if cand and os.path.isfile(cand):
+            return cand
+    return ""
+
+

def render_session_md(info, messages, md_max):
    model = info.get("model") or {}
    tokens = info.get("tokens") or {}
    lines = [
        f"# {info.get('title') or 'Untitled session'}",
        "",
        f"- session: `{info.get('id')}`",
        f"- project dir: `{info_location(info, '?')}`",
        f"- started: {iso((info.get('time') or {}).get('created'))}"
        f" · last activity: {iso((info.get('time') or {}).get('updated'))}",
        f"- model: `{model.get('providerID', '?')}/{model.get('id', '?')}`"
        f" · agent: `{info.get('agent', '?')}`",
    ]
    if tokens:
        cache = tokens.get("cache") or {}
        lines.append(
            "- tokens: "
            f"in={tokens.get('input', 0)} out={tokens.get('output', 0)} "
            f"reasoning={tokens.get('reasoning', 0)} "
            f"cache r={cache.get('read', 0)}/w={cache.get('write', 0)}"
        )
        if info.get("cost") is not None:
            lines[-1] += f" · cost: ${info.get('cost'):.4f}"
    lines.append(
        f" · outcome: `{info.get('outcome', '?')}`"
        if False else
        f"- outcome: `{info.get('outcome', '?')}`"
    )
    lines.extend([
        "",
        "Rendered by `scripts/export-agent-log` from `opencode session export`."
        " Tool outputs are capped for readability; the full fidelity data"
        " (every input and byte of output) is in the paired `.jsonl` file.",
        "",
        "---",
        "",
    ]
    n_user = sum(1 for m in messages if m.get("type") == "user")
    n_assistant = sum(1 for m in messages if m.get("type") == "assistant")
    lines.append(
        f"_{n_user} user prompts, {n_assistant} assistant"
        f" turns, {len(messages)} messages total (incl. events)._"
    )
    lines.append("")

    for i, msg in enumerate(messages, 1):
        lines.append(render_message_md(msg, i, info.get("id", ""), md_max))
        lines.append("")
    return "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"
